summary: An application menu bar: a row of dropdown menus, each built from the same item list as Menu.

props.name: menus
props.description: Each menu's `label`, its `items`, and an optional `disabled`. Every menu owns its own open state, so opening one closes the last.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the bar, its buttons, the popups and their items together.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on the bar's buttons and the popups. Not on the bar itself - that is what both shadow demos did.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Which end of an item its `icon` sits at. A `shortcut` always trails regardless.

props.name: animate
props.description: The popups' fade in/out. Turn it off for instant menus, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the bar's classes, so any Yumma CSS utility you pass wins.
